definitions.explanation: So outstanding that there is no equal in the world. A literary term most commonly used to describe beauty.

examples.japanese: {絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: She was called a peerless beauty.

examples.japanese: クレオパトラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Cleopatra is known as a peerless beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧{絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I'm reading a book that collects stories of peerless beauties who left their names in history.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the fixed phrase {絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧ (peerless beauty). A literary and somewhat dramatic expression. Can also appear as {絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧. Rarely used with other nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧ (peerless beauty — woman)
- {絶世|ぜっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧ (peerless beauty — person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {比類|ひるい}なき: unparalleled — literary, broader usage
- {無双|むそう}: peerless, unmatched — used for strength or skill
